# Code of conduct

This repository is a place to build a radio together.

- Be decent to the people here, whatever their level. Everyone started with a first wire.
- Talk about the work: the part, the step, the line of code.
- No harassment, no insults, no attacks on anyone's identity, and no sharing of anyone's private details.
- Keep the game's mysteries for the game. Do not post solutions to The Black Watchmen's puzzles here.

I remove comments, issues and pull requests that break these rules, and I block accounts that keep breaking them.
To report a problem with someone's behaviour, use the private report on the
[Security tab](https://github.com/Anashel-RPG/ws79-radio/security/advisories/new) and start the title with
"Conduct".
